description: This bar chart illustrates the popularity scores for different large language models across three knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis represents the knowledge domain categories—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—listed in that order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Popularity,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 220, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals.  For each knowledge domain, there are six bars representing different language models: Llama3 (light blue), Qwen2 (dark blue), ChatGPT (orange), Acc=0 & GT Ans (red, hatched), Acc=0 & Gene Ans (red, dotted), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (red, solid).  In the “Movies” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 24, while the Acc=1 & GT Ans bar reaches approximately 32. For “Songs,” the Llama3 bar extends to around 62, and the Acc=1 & GT Ans bar reaches approximately 78.  In the “Basketball” category, the Llama3 bar reaches a value of approximately 186, while the Acc=0 & GT Ans bar reaches the highest value at approximately 208. The bars are arranged in groups of six, one group per knowledge domain, and are not sorted by popularity within each group. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
